sources.location: https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2024/03/PXD047727/; ZIP central-directory byte ranges saved in scratchpad/PXD047727/*.tail.bin and nks1_raw_tail.bin
NKS1_RFP_MQ.zip and QUA1_GFP_MQ.zip in the PRIDE archive; extracted scratchpad/PXD047727/nks1_mqpar.xml and qua1_mqpar.xml

claims.value: 15 vendor .d directories, one per deposited ZIP archive
claims.evidence: The PRIDE list has five groups of three RAW ZIP archives. Each ZIP central directory identifies exactly one .d root; public archive names use underscores while internal vendor directories use spaces and hyphens.

claims.location: source name, characteristics[biological replicate], comment[technical replicate]
claims.value: three individual plants per group; one run per plant
claims.evidence: Sample processing protocol says samples in triplicates from three individual plants; deposited names carry Rep1 to Rep3 for each bait/control group.

claims.location: characteristics[organism], characteristics[organism part], characteristics[strain or breed]
claims.evidence: Project protocol specifies whole leaves from three-week-old NKS1-mRFP, QUA1-GFP, and Col-0 plants; paper identifies Col-0 background.

claims.value: NKS1-mRFP, ST-mRFP Golgi-marker control, QUA1-GFP, or untagged Col-0 with corresponding RFP-Trap or GFP-Trap
claims.evidence: Archive group names encode NKS1, ST, QUA1 and Col-0 controls. Paper identifies ST-mRFP as a Golgi marker; protocol identifies RFP-Trap and GFP-Trap agarose.
Data processing protocol names timsTOF pro and PASEF mode.

claims.location: comment[cleavage agent details], comment[reduction reagent], comment[alkylation reagent]
claims.evidence: Data processing protocol names 20 ug/ml trypsin and DTT in elution buffer 1, chloroacetamide in elution buffer 2, followed by overnight incubation and 'tryptic peptide mixtures'.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance], comment[modification parameters]
claims.value: 10 ppm precursor; 40 ppm TOF fragment; carbamidomethyl C fixed, oxidation M and protein N-terminal acetylation variable
claims.evidence: Both deposited mqpar.xml search configurations encode these settings.

limitations: The public ZIP archive names differ from the internal vendor .d directory names. SDRF comment[data file] uses the verified inner directory names.

The MaxQuant configuration's internal acquisition names differ from the public archive names; shared search settings are supported by both deposited NKS1 and QUA1 configurations, but individual internal search names are not mapped to public runs.
The automated reconciler checks the sample processing protocol and flags cleavage_agent_unsupported; the PRIDE data processing protocol explicitly documents trypsin digestion.
The PRIDE record says plants were three weeks old, but no controlled developmental stage term was established; the SDRF uses not available.
